name: Crowdfunding Pre-Sales Campaign
phase: Low-Fidelity Prototyping and Smoke Testing Tactics
hypothesis: We believe there is sustained market demand for our hardware/software innovation. We will verify this by launching a 30-day public crowdfunding campaign, and consider it validated if the campaign hits its minimum funding goal of $100,000 from at least 500 individual backers.
schematic: Pledge at step 2 of the 3-step strip

plan.label: Preparation
plan.text: Make the campaign video, fix production dates, cost the bill of materials and set the reward tiers.

plan.label: Execution
plan.text: Launch publicly and run coordinated promotion through the target consumer and industry channels.

plan.label: Data collection
plan.text: Track day-one funding velocity, page conversion, tier mix and average pledge.

planFull.label: Preparation
planFull.text: Produce a campaign video, establish production timelines, map out detailed bill-of-materials cost structures, and configure the campaign page and reward tiers.

planFull.label: Execution
planFull.text: Launch the campaign publicly and run coordinated promotional campaigns across targeted consumer and industry channels.

planFull.label: Data collection
planFull.text: Track day-one funding velocity, campaign page conversion rates, backer tier distribution, and average pledge amounts.

warning.label: Early-Adopter Crowdfunding Bubble
warning.text: Crowdfunding draws hobbyists who tolerate delay and bugs, not mainstream buyers.

warningFull: Crowdfunding platforms attract early adopters and hobbyists who tolerate delays and product bugs; these users rarely reflect the expectations of mainstream mass-market consumers.
